name: AI Calculators
tagline: Free AI cost calculators for LLM API, caching, ROI, VRAM, RAG and AI video.
description:
AI Calculators offers free AI-related cost calculators, including LLM API cost, prompt caching savings, AI ROI, VRAM, RAG token budget and AI video cost calculators, to help teams estimate what AI actually costs before they build or scale.

Watch out: three requests on 2026-11-14, including https://aicalculators.xyz/ and https://www.aicalculators.xyz/, returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare "Just a moment" page. The submitted description is a set of AI cost calculators. This desk could not read the calculator pages through that challenge. A later WebFetch of the same URL returned HTTP 504. The domain answered. It was not a for-sale or parked page in those responses.
